assessment: This study presents a valuable finding on the role of secretory leukocyte protease inhibitors (SLPIs) in developing Lyme disease in mice infected with Borrelia burgdorferi. The evidence supporting the authors' claims is solid. However, several concerns raised by the reviewers remain unaddressed. This paper would be of interest to scientists in the infectious inflammatory disease field.
